adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, the booking attendees are persisted first via prisma.booking.update(... createMany ...) and only afterwards the external calendar is updated via `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` with no try/catch/compensation. If `updateCalendarAttendees` throws, the mutation will fail after the DB write, leaving guests added in the DB but not synced to the calendar (partial/inconsistent state). The finding’s “no test” part isn’t verifiable from the diff, but the lack of error handling/rollback around the calendar sync is directly shown.
